attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2996/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is not the corpus's `mercurius`, the great-martyr and soldier the Romanian keeps on 25 November, nor `mercurius-the-faster`, whose own Greek row the corpus already keeps on 4 November and who is the other Mercurius of this same listing; the place in the display name is the page's own «ὁ ἐν Σμολένσκῃ». The page's whole content is its name-gloss and the sentence that there are no details, so there is no `dates` object, no `office` and no `locations`, and `types: ["martyr"]` rests on the rank word «Άγιος» in the line and on nothing else the page says. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
